utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the twenty-fourth. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Only just made it in, mind. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Standard Friday, then. Everyone trying to start the weekend before they've started work.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I was mostly trying to get past the same bus for twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Well, the heating in the portakabin thinks it's November. Lovely coming in here in July and getting slow-roasted.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That explains the red face. Thought your camera had gone funny.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, that's genuinely me. Just having a moan, not adding the heating to the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. We haven't got a column for lightly cooked mechanical engineer.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, before we get onto the actions, anything already finished that needs taking off?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, finished the repair on the GT1 last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: All closed, rather than something you're bringing into this morning?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: All closed. Just reporting it back, no new job there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing on Tuesday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, so that isn't a carry-over inspection?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, already signed off. It just keeps getting mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: While we're on updates, I saw the pressure on the WHB dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Recovered without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Just an observation, I'm not raising a job for it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing here: saw the pressure on the GT2 bearing dip for a few minutes, then it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's separate from the inspection I mentioned, just so we don't muddle those together.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Only passing on what I saw, not another inspection request.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, actual actions now. Let's keep the closed stuff out of them.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller on the 3rd. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, just the lock-out tag-out sign-off you're taking there, not a separate repair?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, just that sign-off. I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Davey on that, on the 3rd. And keep the production hold against it so the priority's clear.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. Needs doing first, not disappearing halfway down the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you go to Kestrel to pick up the replacement parts for the pick and place on two?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do that. I can take the collection.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's collecting the parts, yeah? Not putting the fitting against the same action?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Correct, collection only. We're not adding a fitting job here.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine. I'll go to Kestrel and pick up the replacement parts for the pick and place on two.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We really do have some wonderfully short equipment names.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Still better than 'the thing beside the other thing', which is what I normally get.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And Grace, can you do the pre-use checks on the forklifts by the 28th? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. By the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Separate entry from the parts run, presumably?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. The date and the fairly important bit are for the pre-use checks.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Got it. I'll do the pre-use checks on the forklifts by the 28th. Two separate actions for me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, the chiller next—

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, before you get into that, we can't get to the Line 3 Chiller until production gives us a window. That's still the blocker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, after lunch is the intended slot, but we haven't got that access released yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you recalibrate the sensors on the Line 3 Chiller after lunch? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry, I can't take that one on. You'll need to give it to somebody else.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay. Sarah, can you take that instead? Recalibrate the sensors on the Line 3 Chiller after lunch, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take it instead. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Line 3 Chiller after lunch, top priority, subject to getting that production window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the distinction, yeah. Having an owner doesn't mean we've suddenly got access.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. After lunch stays the timing. I won't start before production releases it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: So the blocker is the access, not a separate piece of work we're assigning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I'm taking the recalibration, with that blocker still visible.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Oh, and before it gets mixed into this, the shutdown on the IM1 is cancelled now. Production need it running.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, cancelled. Not something we're carrying on today's action list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Correct. No shutdown to do.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good to be clear. Hearing 'window' and 'shutdown' back-to-back makes it sound like the same conversation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, different things. The IM1 shutdown is off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one. Not an emergency but don't let it slip — that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers, Cal. The purchase order chase is yours, then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, mine. It doesn't need the emergency treatment, but I'm not letting it drift.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And that's the order we're talking about, not an action on the equipment itself?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just chasing the purchase order for the turbine one. Nothing else added.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the actions agreed. Anything we've accidentally left sounding open that should be closed?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing from me. GT1 repair stays in the finished pile, please.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the pressure dip I mentioned stays as an observation. Not another job hiding in the notes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, clear. Thanks, everyone. I'll stop baking in here and let you go.
